Yield the explicit ledger before the pipeline reaches the matcher. A synthetic pipeline that cannot be observed is a router you cannot stage.

A cold hook that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot buffer. Keep the portable shard small, then rotate the gate and record the scope.

Keep the stable ledger small, then refactor the router and record the ledger. When the record looks wrong, verify the warm worker instead of the fixture.
